notes.title: Rorschach Plus and You - An overly pretentious update
notes.content:
Hello all,
Sorry for basically abandoning this game despite it having major gamebreaking bugs. I've been burnt out of game development for a while, but they're fixed now, and I'm sorry. Hopefully the new features might entice you to give Rorschach (PLUS!) another shot!

So what's changed?
- Reduced download size by nearly 66%! (From a ~750mb download size to ~250mb download size!)
- Added Linux support! (Both 64 and 32 bit versions are available! This should mean that Rorschach is fully playable on Steam Deck, too!)
- Fixed major gamebreaking bug with enemies not following loops
- Fixed major gamebreaking bug with gravity balls borking controls
- Fixed inconsistent jump methods between keyboards and controllers
- Added a cool new mouse cursor
- Fixed steam overlay ghosting

Again, thanks for dealing with my incompetence and laziness. I look forward to seeing what you think of the new definitive edition of Rorschach!

Cheers,
- EmCannon

notes.title: Rorschach 2.0 Release!
notes.content:
Rorschach's biggest update has just been released!

This update includes...
- 25 new levels
- 2 new items
- 3 new achievements
- A hefty dose of bug fixes
[strike]- And the removal of herobrine[/strike]

To celebrate, the game will be on sale for %50 off for an extended period of time!

Enjoy!

- EmCannon
